author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** Establish the four-crate workspace layout `.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` REQ-7 and §I depend on. Lock conventions here so they propagate.

**Deliverables.**
- Root `Cargo.toml`: `[workspace] members = ["polaris-types", "polaris-backend", "polaris-frontend", "xtask"]`, `resolver = "2"`, `rust-version = "1.85"` (matches proto-blue).
- `[workspace.package]`: license `"MIT"`, repository, edition.
- `[workspace.dependencies]`: shared pins — `axum`, `sqlx` (features: `runtime-tokio-rustls`, `postgres`, `macros`, `migrate`), `tokio` (full), `leptos`, `proto-blue = "0.3"`, `anyhow`, `thiserror`, `tracing`, `tracing-subscriber`, `serde`, `serde_json`, `uuid`, `chrono`.
- `[workspace.lints.rust]` + `[workspace.lints.clippy]` strict baseline; `clippy.toml` for project-specific (`doc-valid-idents = ["AT-URI","DAG-CBOR","did:plc","NSID"]`).
- Empty crate skeletons (`Cargo.toml` + `src/lib.rs` or `src/main.rs`).
- `rust-toolchain.toml` pinning rustc.
- `.gitignore` (`target/`, `*.log`, `.env`, `*.swp`).
- README quickstart.

**References.**
- `.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` REQ-7, AC-8, §A, §I.
- design.md §4 (types defined here, used in M1).
- proto-blue `0.3.1` on crates.io (recheck before pin).
- Rust API Guidelines: C-COMMON-TRAITS, C-NEWTYPE, C-CRATE-DOC.

**Rust-quality.**
- `lints.workspace = true` in every member.
- `#![warn(missing_docs)]` + `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` workspace-wide.
- `polaris-types` deps: only `serde`/`serde_json`/`uuid`/`chrono`. No proto-blue, no sqlx.
- Newtype IDs (`pub struct SubjectId(Uuid);`), not aliases.
- Re-exports curated; no `pub use foo::*;` in lib roots.

**Testing.**
- `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` clean.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo fmt --check` clean.

**Done when.** All four crates build empty; `polaris-types` has no proto-blue in its tree (AC-8 first half).
